messages:
Olivia (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — we need to get AWS/GCP/Azure listing preflight done this week. Priority: IAM roles, KMS key access, SKU mapping for trial vs paid, and a packaging.json that includes trial limits. @Jason (Legal) @Priya (Product) available for a 30m tomorrow?
Jason (Legal): I can do 11:30am PT. need to confirm any export controls + sample T&Cs for trial. will surface the checklist. :eyes:
Priya (Product): 11:30 works. I'll bring the packaging draft (trial duration, usage caps). also need guidance on what we show in the store listing (screenshots vs feature bullets).
David (Ops): For KMS/IAM, we need a service account pattern and an allowlist CIDR for private offers. minimal IAM snippet below for the publisher role: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}]
}
```
David (Ops): Also: will need a staging AMI/container and a region manifest. I can provision sandbox creds once legal signs off.
marketplace-bot: Sandbox creds request received. Link to temp creds: https://internal.redwood/sandbox/creds/abc123 (expires in 72h). :robot_face:
Luis (Design): FYI — screenshots for listing should be 1200x628 and include two short captions. I'll draft visuals after the product cap is confirmed.
Sara (Growth): Do we want a 14-day trial or usage-based trial? growth prefers fixed 14d to simplify billing trials. we should list trial terms in the store notes.
Emma (Partnerships): Suggest we maintain a single packaging.json canon in the repo: repo: //marketplace/packaging/marketplace-packaging.json — can someone add the initial draft? priya?
Priya (Product): Added a first pass to the repo under //marketplace/drafts/packaging-v1.json. includes: {"trial_days":14,"seat_limit":1,"api_rate_limit_per_min":60}. open to comments.
Jason (Legal): I'll post redlines by EOD. main asks: data residency note for EU customers, and a short snippet for the EULA around allowed usage.
Olivia (Partnerships): Great — plan: sync 11:30am PT tomorrow, David to attach staging manifest, Priya to update packaging.json with UI copy, Jason to bring legal redlines, Luis to draft screenshots. Action owners pinned. :thumbsup:
Emma (Partnerships): I'll own the Marketplace intake ticket and the offer ID mapping once we get the final packaging.json. creating ticket now.
marketplace-bot: Ticket created: MP-4589 — "Redwood: initial listing preflight (AWS/GCP/Azure)" — assignees: Emma, Olivia. Link: https://linear.redwood/MP-4589
Olivia (Partnerships): Thanks all — if anything blocks before the sync drop a note here.
